```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const lon = 157.706220, lat = -34.344553;
    const geom = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]).buffer(100000); // 100 km
    const p1Start = '2018-11-01', p1End = '2019-03-01';
    const p2Start = '2019-11-01', p2End = '2020-03-01';
    const scale = 25000; // coarse suitable for reanalysis

    // 2. Dataset acquisition with fallback and band detection
    const datasetIds = [
      'NASA/GEOS/MERRA2/M2TMNXAER',
      'ECMWF/CAMS/REANALYSIS',
      'ECMWF/CAMS/NRT',
      'NASA/GEOS/MERRA2/M2T1NXAER'
    ];
    const bandCandidatesPriority = [
      'BCEXTTAU',
      'aod550_black_carbon',
      'aod550bc',
      'black_carbon_optical_depth_550nm',
      'bcaod550',
      'bcaod',
      'AODBC'
    ];
    async function tryPickBand(ic) {
      const bn = await ic.first().bandNames().getInfo();
      if (!bn) return null;
      const lower = bn.map(b => String(b).toLowerCase());
      // exact priority
      for (const cand of bandCandidatesPriority) {
        const idx = bn.findIndex(b => b === cand);
        if (idx !== -1) return bn[idx];
      }
      // heuristic search
      for (let i = 0; i < bn.length; i++) {
        const b = lower[i];
        if ((b.includes('bc') || b.includes('black')) && (b.includes('aod') || b.includes('ext') || b.includes('tau')) && (b.includes('550') || b.includes('aer') || b.includes('opt'))) {
          return bn[i];
        }
      }
      return null;
    }
    async function findWorkingDataset() {
      for (const id of datasetIds) {
        try {
          let ic = ee.ImageCollection(id).filterBounds(geom);
          // Ensure both periods have images
          const n1 = await ic.filterDate(p1Start, p1End).size().getInfo();
          const n2 = await ic.filterDate(p2Start, p2End).size().getInfo();
          if ((n1 || 0) === 0 || (n2 || 0) === 0) continue;
          const band = await tryPickBand(ic);
          if (!band) continue;
          return { id, ic, band, n1, n2 };
        } catch (e) {
          continue;
        }
      }
      return null;
    }
    const ds = await findWorkingDataset();
    if (!ds) {
      console.log('Dataset: None found for BC AOD with both periods.');
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing
    const ic1 = ds.ic.filterDate(p1Start, p1End).select([ds.band]);
    const ic2 = ds.ic.filterDate(p2Start, p2End).select([ds.band]);
    // Means over time
    const img1 = ic1.mean();
    const img2 = ic2.mean();

    // Pixel counts and means over region
    const count1 = await img1.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get(ds.band).getInfo();

    const count2 = await img2.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get(ds.band).getInfo();

    if (!count1 || !count2 || count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${ds.id}, Band: ${ds.band}`);
      console.log(`P1 Images: ${ds.n1}, P2 Images: ${ds.n2}`);
      console.log('Valid Pixels P1: ' + (count1 || 0) + ', P2: ' + (count2 || 0));
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    const mean1 = await img1.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get(ds.band).getInfo();

    const mean2 = await img2.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get(ds.band).getInfo();

    // 4. Validation
    const valid = (v) => v !== null && v !== undefined && isFinite(v) && v >= 0 && v <= 10;
    if (!valid(mean1) || !valid(mean2)) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${ds.id}, Band: ${ds.band}`);
      console.log(`P1 Images: ${ds.n1}, P2 Images: ${ds.n2}`);
      console.log(`Means invalid: P1=${mean1}, P2=${mean2}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Output concise evidence and final answer
    const diff = mean2 - mean1;
    const pct = mean1 > 0 ? (diff / mean1) * 100 : null;
    console.log(`Dataset: ${ds.id}, Band: ${ds.band}`);
    console.log(`P1 Images: ${ds.n1}, P2 Images: ${ds.n2}`);
    console.log(`Valid Pixels P1: ${count1}, P2: ${count2}`);
    console.log(`P1 Mean BC AOD: ${mean1.toFixed(6)}`);
    console.log(`P2 Mean BC AOD: ${mean2.toFixed(6)}`);
    console.log(`Diff: ${diff.toFixed(6)}${pct !== null ? ` (${pct.toFixed(1)}%)` : ''}`);

    // Decision: increase if P2 > P1 (with tiny tolerance)
    const increased = diff > Math.max(1e-5, mean1 * 0.01); // >1% or >1e-5 absolute
    console.log(increased ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    // Any unexpected error -> D
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
